metadata.defaultTitle: XTT — Wholesale distributor of CX and telecom solutions
metadata.defaultDescription: Wholesale distributor of contact center, SIP telephony and digital channel technology across Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia.

hero.title: Four solutions. One partner network.
hero.subtitle: We bring contact center and telecom technology to the partners serving Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia.

about.title: We are a distributor, not another reseller.
about.lead: A 100% Mexican company founded in 2018. We distribute communications and AI-as-a-service technology, and we work exclusively through partners: our business is making theirs work.
about.body: We never compete with our partners for the end account. We provide the catalog, the training, the technical presales and the support a partner needs to sell and deploy — without carrying the infrastructure or managing a direct relationship with every vendor.
about.mission: To be the distributor that grows its partners: bringing them dependable contact center and telecom technology, and standing with them through the sale, the deployment and the support.
about.vision: To build the strongest distribution ecosystem in the region: trained partners, first-tier vendors, and customers who evolve without friction.

solutions.title: What we distribute
solutions.lead: Four lines that sell on their own or together, depending on what each partner already serves.

ccaas.name: CCaaS
ccaas.summary: Cloud contact center: omnichannel, intelligent routing and analytics, with no infrastructure of your own.
ccaas.detail: Contact center platforms operated as a service. The partner sells the whole solution — voice, digital, reporting and AI-assisted agents — without standing up or maintaining a single server.

sbc-telecom-data.name: SBCs and telecom data analysis
sbc-telecom-data.full: Session Border Controllers and traffic analytics
sbc-telecom-data.summary: Secure and normalize SIP traffic, and turn CDR into decisions.
sbc-telecom-data.detail: Session Border Controllers to protect the network edge, normalize signaling between carriers and resolve interoperability. On top, the analytics layer that turns call detail into insight on usage, quality and fraud.

messaging.name: Messaging and digital channels
messaging.summary: WhatsApp, SMS, RCS and social in the same service flow as voice.
messaging.detail: Digital channels wired into the contact center, not parked in a separate inbox. Includes transactional messaging, campaigns, and the APIs to connect them to the CRM the customer already runs.

sip.name: SIP telephony
sip.summary: Regional coverage, portability and quality measured end to end.
sip.detail: SIP trunks and numbering with regional coverage, portability and quality monitoring. The foundation the contact center and the digital channels rest on.

presence.title: Where we operate
presence.lead: We have presence across Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia.
